level.1-2.intro.0.t: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.
